thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: runtime-prod canary latency > 2x baseline for 5m. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Auto-escalation to #incidents.

maya: seeing the alert. can anyone confirm if a recent deploy hit canary?

raj: yes, pushed quantized-kernel-optimizer v2.3 to canary 10m ago (deploy-bot). low risk but changed kernel selection heuristics.

olivia: on it. pulling runtime metrics now — p95 spiking from 120ms -> 800ms on canary nodes, throughput dropping ~40%.

jorge: logs show a lot of kernel-fallback warnings like: 
```
WARN kernel_selector: incompatible tiled matmul kernel, falling back to generic kernel for model-id:xg-13b
```
and continuous KV cache miss churn.

maya: that matches reports: fallback kernels are much slower. any idea why selector chose incompatible kernel?

raj: quick read: the optimizer started preferring int8 AVX512 path but canary hosts are a mix of older SKUs without that feature. policy should have filtered, looks like a mismatch in node-label targeting.

olivia: who owns node labeling for canary fleet?

jorge: infra owns labels, but the deploy manifest included a hard-coded kernel_target: avx512 in canary rollout config — that should have been validated.

sre-oncall: paging oncall infra to check labels. @infra-team please ack.

incident-bot: oncall-handoff requested: @sre-oncall assigned.

maya: mitigation options: 1) flip feature flag to disable new kernel selection heuristic, 2) rollback canary to previous image, 3) add exclusion for older host SKUs via runtime config. fastest is flag kill-switch.

raj: flag is on a shared config service. I can flip to fallback_disable: true. That will force old selector.

olivia: note: we also see batching queue depth decreasing then bursting which is amplifying latency spikes. probably because fallback kernel increases per-request latency so batching backpressure misaligns.

jorge: confirmed node labels are inconsistent — some canary nodes lost `cpu_features: avx512` label after an autoscaler update earlier today. infra will patch, but not immediate.

sre-oncall: recommend immediate kill-switch + pause canary rollout. who can flip flag now?

raj: I'm flipping the flag now.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by raj: toggle feature flag kernel_heuristic=false in config/service/runtime-configs/global at 2026-02-12T16:20:12Z.

maya: watching metrics... p95 on canary is starting to come down. throughput ticking back up.

olivia: still some nodes with fallback logs but overall latency improving to ~200ms p95. We should pause further rollouts.

raj: I’m also pausing the canary pipeline and marking the release as blocked.

deploy-bot: pipeline paused: release quantized-kernel-optimizer v2.3 (canary) by raj at 2026-02-12T16:22:03Z.

sre-oncall: good. initiate customer-impact assessment: any external 5xx or error spikes?

olivia: 5xx rate stable. No user-facing errors detected, but increased tail latency could affect SLAs for some enterprise customers. pulling token-level latency slices now.

maya: quick check with sales eng: @olivia can you flag any high-traffic accounts in the last 30m?

olivia: pinged account-eng for top 10 customers. so far no inbound support tickets.

jorge: infra will add a label reconciliation job and temporarily taint old-sku nodes out of canary rotation. but that is a medium impact fix, ETA ~1h.

raj: we should do a clean rollback to v2.2 on canary once flag proves stable, to be safe. I can roll back the image tomorrow once infra fixes targeting. For now, flag kill-switch remains.

maya: agree. also create a postmortem runbook item: deployment validation should include node-feature gating.

sre-oncall: handoff to night oncall in 30m. summary to include: root cause suspected kernel selection + stale node labels; impact: latency spike on canary only, no 5xx, no customer tickets; mitigations: feature-flag kill, paused pipeline, infra reconciling labels, rollback planned.

raj: adding run commands used: 
```
# check fallback logs
kubectl -n runtime logs -l app=kernel-selector --since=15m | grep fallback
# flip flag
curl -X POST https://config-api.internal/v1/flags/kernel_heuristic -d '{"value":false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

maya: have we notified SRE lead and PM?

olivia: SRE lead @jorge informed. PM and account-eng notified about potential latency exposure (no SLA breach expected).

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied (feature flag off). monitoring for 30m.

sre-oncall: handoff notes prepared. @night-sre please pick up at 17:00 UTC.

maya: thanks everyone. once infra finishes label reconciliation let's re-run the canary in a controlled window with stricter node filters.

raj: filing a follow-up ticket: #INFRA-4289 add node-feature gating to canary deployment + preflight validation.

olivia: I'll open the incident postmortem doc and seed timeline. reference metrics: p95 graph, deployment audit, logs.

maya: closing for now as impact limited and mitigated. will reopen if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
